verdict.rationale: Mapping tablet or phone touch and stylus input to host pointer events is a fair question for a remote-access product like TeamViewer, so the axis applies. Nothing in the pack documents touch-to-pointer or stylus mapping from mobile clients. The 'Mobile SDK (add-on)' pricing mention is a developer building block, not this capability, and earns no credit.

support.subject: As a power user, touch and stylus input on a tablet or phone maps to pointer events on the host
